information.en: Resampled target-space B0 and predicted shimmed B0 with absolute settings in image comments
Registered signed Hz/A profiles on the target grid and verified absolute A limits. Requires the field-map acquisition currents. Saved measured profiles require identical target geometry.

label.en: Field-map acquisition shim currents in A

information.en: JSON array or named object of actual currents used for the selected field-map acquisition. A known saved baseline cannot be replaced. Calibration profiles must match the target grid exactly.
Explicit patient RAS to shim LAI isocentre geometry and verified absolute native bounds for the selected field map. Ideal estimate. Saved acquisition geometry remains authoritative.
JSON named object for the selected B0 field map. X,Y,Z in uT/m; second order in uT/m^2. Required with the analytical model. A saved baseline cannot be replaced.

Actual settings used for the selected B0 field-map acquisition, not the target scan. Enter 3 or 8 values in order X,Y,Z or X,Y,Z,Z2,ZX,ZY,X2-Y2,XY. X,Y,Z in uT/m; remaining in uT/m^2. Requires both limits and HFS isocentre. A saved baseline cannot be replaced.

Enter 3 or 8 comma-separated values in order X,Y,Z or X,Y,Z,Z2,ZX,ZY,X2-Y2,XY. X,Y,Z in uT/m; remaining channels in uT/m^2. All three native vectors must have the same length. Use actual acquisition values and verified limits; no values are assumed.

Enter 3 or 8 comma-separated values in order X,Y,Z or X,Y,Z,Z2,ZX,ZY,X2-Y2,XY. X,Y,Z in uT/m; remaining channels in uT/m^2. All three native vectors must have the same length. Use actual acquisition values and verified limits; no values are assumed.

Explicit magnet isocentre in patient RAS mm for confirmed head-first supine: R,A,S. Enter 3 comma-separated values, including explicit zeros. Never substitute image centre. Required with direct native baseline and bounds; leave all four blank to use existing shim inputs.

Required exact B0MapId shown in the source b0mapromeo image comments. Reads /tmp/share/b0maps/<ID>. Select the correct field map for this patient and unchanged coordinate frame. No latest-map fallback. Both containers must mount the same host share.
